title: Nacre Structure
text_faithful_view: The text-faithful view is a gate made of a single pearl, smooth and iridescent.
engineering_view: The engineering view is nacre: thin plates of calcium carbonate separated by organic layers, whose layered structure produces iridescence by interference. Real nacre is a natural composite, not a single gemstone slab.
body: Signature-original design: a Signature nacre model approximating published microstructure, with its own plate-thickness range. The engineering view is nacre: thin plates of calcium carbonate separated by organic layers, whose layered structure produces iridescence by interference. Real nacre is a natural composite, not a single gemstone slab. This record is ordered at ladder rank 1, from simple toward compounded and complex, and its demo computes real values from the parameters stated in this record.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Nacre Structure'

INCIDENT = 1000.0
T = 0.12
R = 0.55
A = 1.0 - T - R
print(TITLE + ' - light transmission calculator')
print('Incident flux: %.1f' % INCIDENT)
print('Transmitted: %.2f (%.1f%%)' % (INCIDENT*T, T*100))
print('Reflected: %.2f (%.1f%%)' % (INCIDENT*R, R*100))
print('Absorbed or scattered: %.2f (%.1f%%)' % (INCIDENT*A, A*100))
demo.expected_output:
Nacre Structure - light transmission calculator
Incident flux: 1000.0
Transmitted: 120.00 (12.0%)
Reflected: 550.00 (55.0%)
Absorbed or scattered: 330.00 (33.0%)

title: Monumental Single-Pearl Infeasibility
text_faithful_view: The text-faithful view is a gate made of one single pearl, large enough for a city gate.
engineering_view: The engineering view states this plainly: a monumental single pearl is not a practical material. No natural pearl grows to gate scale, and no demonstrated process grows or carves a single pearl gate. The buildable interpretation is engineered nacre-inspired panels, and that interpretation is not the same thing as a single pearl. Claiming otherwise would be false.
body: Signature-original design: a Signature statement of the same limit, with engineered panels as the buildable interpretation, labeled Signature-original where speculative. The engineering view states this plainly: a monumental single pearl is not a practical material. No natural pearl grows to gate scale, and no demonstrated process grows or carves a single pearl gate. The buildable interpretation is engineered nacre-inspired panels, and that interpretation is not the same thing as a single pearl. Claiming otherwise would be false. This record is ordered at ladder rank 12, from simple toward compounded and complex, and its demo computes real values from the parameters stated in this record.
